answer: Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 651 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the voyage log shows the live set and the ember audit records each lapse. Keeping 170 aliases alive hence means 170 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the river quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. That is 40 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
